items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Joe Chambers, Ron, and Chick were the rhythm section for Shades of Light and Windows.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe Chambers, Ron, and Chick were the rhythm section for Shades of Light and Windows. That’s why I know that. So I know he was on that date. I don’t remember how he got on it. Maybe I made the request for it, because of my impression of him playing with Miles.
